scope: Compact values used by the current English HerbHG manuscript

manuscript.value_policy: CSV values reproduce the displayed manuscript precision; additional digits appear only in the separate seed-43 confirmation and planned-test files cited by the manuscript text.

snapshot_files.dataset_statistics.csv: Table tab:dataset_statistics plus the two approximate H-D densities stated in the dataset text
snapshot_files.reported_comparisons.csv: Relative improvements stated in Section sec:comparative_evaluation and the conclusion
snapshot_files.relation_perturbation.csv: Table tab:relation_perturbation plus the unperturbed reference plotted at 0 percent
snapshot_files.cold_start.csv: Table tab:coldstart and the accompanying MRR/NDCG statement
snapshot_files.semantic_control_tests.csv: Planned AUROC/AUPRC paired tests underlying the Holm-adjusted statement in Section sec:semantic_controls
Separate seed-43 adapter confirmation cited in the comparison text

metric_conventions.AUROC: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve computed from continuous prediction scores.
metric_conventions.AUPRC: Trapezoidal area under the precision-recall curve computed from continuous prediction scores.
metric_conventions.main_comparison_sd: Sample standard deviation across five outer folds unless the row source states otherwise.
metric_conventions.component_ablation_sd: The five historical ablation variants retain population SD across folds. The full-model row reproduces the manuscript-facing values; its archived fold metrics yield Recall SD 0.0008 when rounded rather than the displayed 0.0009.
metric_conventions.blank_sd: The current manuscript displays only a mean; an empty cell does not represent zero variance.
metric_conventions.cold_start_sd: Population standard deviation across five distinct target herbs, preserved from the displayed manuscript source.
metric_conventions.semantic_sd: Sample standard deviation across the same five target herbs.
metric_conventions.pair_level_threshold: For strict HerbHG pair-level runs, maximize F1 over 100 thresholds on each inner-validation split and apply the chosen threshold unchanged to its outer test fold. Source-specific deviations are retained in row limitations.
metric_conventions.ranking_metrics: Hits@10, Precision@10, Recall@10, MRR, and NDCG@10 evaluate recovery of recorded associations withheld from training.

tcm_suite_strict_seed42.selection: Training is fixed at 16 epochs. The operating threshold is selected on inner validation and then applied unchanged to the outer test fold.

ethnobotany_corrected_seed42.negative_construction: Retain the first occurrence of 16059 stored unobserved pairs and sample 58 additional complement pairs without replacement.
ethnobotany_corrected_seed42.interpretation: The displayed seed-42 residual-MLP outer scores are descriptive because the architecture and fold checkpoints were selected from seed-42 inner-validation results.

ethnobotany_adapter_seed43.purpose: Additional frozen-split comparison of the linear and residual-MLP semantic adapters.
ethnobotany_adapter_seed43.interpretation: Same-dataset additional split; not external validation and no significance claim.

cold_start_seed42.target_selection: Five herbs sampled from the 20 herbs with the largest unique H-C degree.
cold_start_seed42.protocol: Remove every H-D record for one target herb, retrain on the remaining balanced H-D data, and rank all 11071 candidate diseases.
cold_start_seed42.test_label_definition: Recorded target-herb H-D association is positive; every other candidate disease is negative under a closed-world evaluation.
cold_start_seed42.threshold_rule: Maximize F1 on the held-out target labels.
cold_start_seed42.summary_definition: Population SD across five distinct target herbs.

semantic_fusion_seed42.training: A separate model is trained for each fixed alpha.
semantic_fusion_seed42.semantic_condition: Legacy semantic embeddings derived from descriptions containing disease-association content.
semantic_fusion_seed42.threshold_rule: Maximize F1 over 100 thresholds on held-out target labels.
semantic_fusion_seed42.summary_definition: Sample SD across five distinct target herbs.
semantic_fusion_seed42.code_provenance: The exact historical runner commit was not captured.

semantic_controls_seed42.summary_definition: Sample SD across five matched target herbs.
semantic_controls_seed42.planned_tests: Two-sided paired t-tests and exact Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; Holm correction within each metric.
semantic_controls_seed42.inference: No planned AUROC or AUPRC comparison is significant after Holm correction.
semantic_controls_seed42.code_provenance: The exact historical execution commit was not captured.

evidence_types.frozen_processed_dataset_audit: Entity and deduplicated relation counts bound to a frozen protocol manifest.
evidence_types.strict_protocol_audit: Frozen folds with inner-validation model and threshold selection followed by outer-test-only evaluation.
evidence_types.corrected_protocol_audit: Frozen corrected Ethnobotany inputs and fold assignments audited from archived predictions.
evidence_types.corrected_protocol_reproduction: Reproduction on corrected Ethnobotany inputs and folds with metric harmonization where stated.
evidence_types.task_adapted_reproduction: A task-adapted local implementation; not necessarily the original authors' complete pipeline.
evidence_types.legacy_task_adapted_reproduction: A task-adapted local implementation retained from an archived input or evaluation setting that is not protocol-matched to corrected rows.
evidence_types.legacy_fixed_epoch_reproduction: An archived fixed-epoch reproduction retained at the manuscript-displayed configuration.
evidence_types.external_benchmark: Values supplied by an upstream benchmark artifact rather than rerun in the current environment.
evidence_types.historical_component_ablation: Archived component-analysis batch retained for the current manuscript.
evidence_types.historical_ablation_reference: Full-model reference from the same archived ablation context.
evidence_types.historical_sensitivity: Archived parameter or perturbation analysis retained for the current manuscript.
evidence_types.legacy_exploratory: Historical held-out-herb experiment retained as an exploratory analysis with its original statistical definition.
evidence_types.planned_paired_test: A planned matched-target statistical comparison from the semantic-control analysis.
evidence_types.post_selection_diagnostic: Descriptive outer evaluation of a configuration selected on the same seed's inner-validation results.
evidence_types.additional_split_confirmation: Predeclared comparison on a separately frozen random split of the same dataset.
evidence_types.manuscript_reported_derived_comparison: A relative improvement reported from unrounded source aggregates in the manuscript text.
evidence_types.withheld_association_recovery: Ranking of recorded associations explicitly removed from training.

source_collections_without_single_file_c.reason: The archived ablation is a multi-directory collection of fold status files; displayed values are additionally bound to the checksummed manuscript.

boundaries: The method-comparison table is a faithful manuscript snapshot and contains mixed evidence types; it must not be interpreted as a newly rerun protocol-unified benchmark.
The current main table omits SMGCL and this snapshot does not add methods absent from that table.
The TCM-suite LHGCE row is the fixed 100-requested-epoch archived configuration displayed by the manuscript.
The Ethnobotany LHGCE row comes from a 1000-requested-epoch run with 999 recorded updates; the manuscript sentence assigning 100 epochs to LHGCE does not describe this row.
TCM-suite HerbHG and HGHDA use fixed 16-epoch training; validation selects the operating threshold rather than a checkpoint.
The full-model ablation Recall SD is retained as displayed in the manuscript (0.0009), while the supporting archived fold metrics round to 0.0008.
The Ethnobotany HerbHG seed-42 row is descriptive post-selection evidence; the separate seed-43 file records the cited adapter confirmation.
Cold-start and semantic analyses are historical exploratory results on five high-degree herbs and retain their original target-level statistics.
Case-study metrics recover recorded associations withheld from training and do not establish prospective novel discoveries.
No raw predictions, checkpoints, embeddings, logs, or manuscript images are included.
